# Step - out_v

`out_v` · `outV` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves from an edge to its out (tail) vertex.

## Forms

```text
out_v()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.e("0").out_v().values("name").next()   // marko
```
